reply.summary: Tanis is a brown-haired sailor who shares one body with his dead sister's ghost. Tanis can slip into sleep to let her drift out, flying and passing through hulls, though the arrangement leaves him helpless when mutineers strike.

feats.scene: Tanis lets his sister's spirit slide through a cabin wall and unbolt the door from inside.
Tanis is frozen solid at the helm and shattered by a single blow.

reply.summary: Rnluna is a bald, hulking enforcer in armoured plating whose implants spit out searing light. Rnluna once befriended a famous archer, was scarred beyond recognition, and now fetches cursed relics for a ruthless spymaster.

feats.scene: Rnluna floods a lobby with white fire and melts the reinforced doors off their frames.
Rnluna keeps fighting with an arrow lodged in his eye and then drags his attacker away.

reply.summary: Raolu is a blue-haired, yellow-eyed warrior who fires dazzling bolts from his gaze. Raolu was jailed in a trap-filled dungeon on a primitive moon and later teamed up with the other prisoners he had been forced to fight.

feats.scene: Raolu stares down a corridor and the twin bolts bore through a bulkhead.
Raolu shrugs off the shock when the dungeon's power surges.

reply.summary: Llvani is a dark-haired captive from a secret lab who throws blinding light from her eyes. Llvani escapes across a frozen waste with a fellow prisoner, is thrown to her pursuers like a shield, and wakes with a new gift for flight.

feats.scene: Llvani burns a trench through the snow with a stream of pure light.
Llvani is tossed between her partner and a hovering ship and lands on her feet.
Llvani rises above the ice field and streaks away at a sprinter's dream speed times ten.

reply.summary: Anrnci is a yellow-eyed reactor-driven war machine built to crush a civil uprising and then abandoned when its handlers lost control. Anrnci scorches forests as it walks, swats elite flyers aside and falls only to a single clever shot at its neck vent.

feats.scene: Anrnci sweeps its chest cannons across a valley and flattens a village.
Anrnci takes combined blasts from four heroes and keeps marching.

reply.summary: Tananco is a towering furnace-bodied weapon worshipped as a deity by a death cult. Tananco can split into man-sized copies that fuse into a colossus, and each rebirth brings flame and ruin to another metropolis.

feats.scene: Tananco merges its army of copies and boils a downtown district to slag.
Tananco is blown apart by a hero's final strike yet its worshippers plan its return.

reply.summary: Ilmeva is a white-haired, horse-bodied guardian of space who patrols a distant sector and goes home to a loving family. Ilmeva barely survives a first meeting with a swarm of hostile arachnids and passes his duty to one of his children.

feats.scene: Ilmeva shapes a glowing wall of green light that crushes a scout cruiser.
Ilmeva retreats from the hostile fleet, hurt but alive after a barrage.

reply.summary: Silcorlan is a brooding loner from a ruined wolf-like people who prefers hunting solo yet answers favours owed to a clever ally. Silcorlan takes a borrowed ring that lets him fly, and is caught and tortured by a warlord before he escapes unseen.

feats.scene: Silcorlan tears the door off a transport pod and hauls out the wounded driver.
Silcorlan endures days of torture in a warlord's cell and never speaks.

reply.summary: Rninuri is a brown-furred, amber-eyed youth remade into a hunting beast by his cold-hearted father. Rninuri flees into the woods, wrecks the machines sent to retrieve him, and is calmed by a gentle telepath before leaving his home for good.

feats.scene: Rninuri smashes a hunter drone against a tree trunk and cracks the trunk in two.
Rninuri takes a volley of stun bolts and keeps charging through the brush.

reply.summary: Ilnaol is a green-eyed soldier whose body was reshaped as a boy into that of a wolf-man, giving him claws, speed and brawn. Ilnaol arrives too late to save his dead homeworld and joins a union of planets so no one else suffers the same fate.

feats.scene: Ilnaol rakes his claws across a hull plate and peels it back like paper.
Ilnaol stands in the barren ruins of a dead city, wounded and unbent.
Ilnaol outruns a speeding hover-car along a canyon road.

reply.summary: Nelos is a seven-and-a-half-foot, white-eyed wolf-like fighter who insists he needs nobody's help. Nelos was swapped for a lookalike by a jealous machine servant, lost for months to a kidnapper, and once travelled back to fight invaders.

feats.scene: Nelos hurls a stone block across a quarry and splits a boulder.
Nelos lies pinned beneath rubble and spurns the offered hand.

reply.summary: Oreau is a blonde prince of a small kingdom who commands the ground itself while his estranged half-sister wanders abroad. Oreau is raised as a champion of his people and keeps a photograph of her close.

feats.scene: Oreau cracks a hillside open and buries a column of invading tanks.
Oreau stands in a rockslide he called himself and walks out clean.

reply.summary: Erusauil is a strawberry-blond secret operative who works with a band of gifted agents for a government bureau. Erusauil is seen only once and prefers to stay out of the spotlight.

feats.scene: Erusauil heaves a slab of pavement upward to block a gunship run.
Erusauil takes a hard fall onto concrete and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Rilucel is a white-haired, yellow-skinned smuggler from a matriarchal world who swaps weight between people and objects. Rilucel can turn herself ghostly, once humiliated an invading army by making their uniforms drift away, and loves a particular fermented drink.

feats.scene: Rilucel makes a guard's rifle heavy as an anvil so he can only drop it.
Rilucel turns intangible and lets a hail of shots pass harmlessly through her.

reply.summary: Rnurn is a flag-waving costumed crusader from a small island nation who dresses like a loyal hound. Rnurn keeps a secret identity, throws a mean tackle and takes pride in defending ordinary streets.

feats.scene: Rnurn tackles a bag thief at full sprint and pins him to the pavement.
Rnurn rolls from a speeding bus and gets up shaking his fist.

reply.summary: Naamo is a blonde government spy who spends her days acting out the part of a wicked outlaw. Naamo secretly reports to a hidden agency and relies on charm and a convincing mask rather than force.

feats.scene: Naamo slaps a nosy colleague to keep her cover intact.
Naamo takes a hard shove from a teammate and plays the victim.

reply.summary: Eruoreora is a gentle, black-eyed missionary whose devotion to hope fuels a ring that never needs recharging. Eruoreora left a dying homeworld behind, now fights with a ring of shimmering blue light and can strengthen allies' own rings with sheer optimism.

feats.scene: Eruoreora weaves a blue beam wide enough to rip a freighter apart.
Eruoreora walks through a barrage while calmly assuring his foes that all will be well.

reply.summary: Eslesaun is a hairless, serene envoy who appears briefly to reassure two humans that their troubles will pass. Eslesaun carries a ring of blue light for blasts and flight, and he falls shortly after speaking.

feats.scene: Eslesaun hurls a hard blue lance from his ring and shatters a stone arch.
Eslesaun is struck down after his calm warning is delivered.

reply.summary: Anrer is a bald convict spared from the electric chair by a sinister preacher who gave him a purple stone-like hide. Anrer hurls cars, smashes through barriers and street surfaces, and fights until the shell finally cracks away.

feats.scene: Anrer throws a sedan through a shop window and tears a crater in the road behind it.
Anrer takes repeated blows from two champions and only a few chips of crust fall away.

reply.summary: Litino is a brown, many-tentacled medic who ferries wounded fighters out of battle and calms them with gentle touches. Litino carries a ring and a charging battery, shields patients with energy bubbles, and trusts will more than weapons.

feats.scene: Litino lashes a green bolt at a pirate gun battery and wrecks it.
Litino's energy bubble keeps a transport pod intact in a crossfire.

reply.summary: Riasuce is a brown-haired hired gun who rides for a hard-hearted frontier boss. Riasuce dies in a dusty gunfight, with nothing to remember him by except a few unpaid debts.

feats.scene: Riasuce fires his revolver and drops a bottle from a fence post.
Riasuce absorbs a saloon brawl and sleeps it off.

reply.summary: Toriute is a black-haired outcast who finds a shaman's staff on a lonely island and soaks it in a brew to summon gales. Toriute terrorises a small hamlet from exile, descends from a landlord family, and his storms rouse a band of teenage heroes.

feats.scene: Toriute whips a funnel of wind through a harbour and tears a pier from its pilings.
Toriute is a thin man in a cape who can be knocked flat by a thrown rock.

reply.summary: Orisill is a black-haired storm-bringer in a possible tomorrow, still plotting against young heroes. Orisill conjures a monstrous hurricane to batter a peninsula until a mature team of champions stops him.

feats.scene: Orisill spins up a hurricane that threatens an entire coastline.
Orisill is knocked cold by a lunging rival after the storm collapses.

reply.summary: Stveoli is a black-haired heir to a long line of masked guardians in a far-future century who trains alone after his father dies. Stveoli avenges his murdered parents, wields the best gadgets of his age and teams up with a mighty flier.

feats.scene: Stveoli swings a weighted grapple into a robot sentry and caves in its torso.
Stveoli is slammed into a steel wall and stays on his feet.

reply.summary: Iuulneo is a brown-haired robot controlled by two scheming aliens who entered a games contest for a power crystal. Iuulneo hurls objects farther than any rival and mocks a famous champion, though splashing water ruins his circuits.

feats.scene: Iuulneo throws a boulder the size of a house clear over the horizon.
Iuulneo shrugs off a ricochet from his own throw.

reply.summary: Anntileo is a brown-skinned child of two engineered mutants, born naturally and kept as a living curiosity in a castle ballroom. Anntileo is freed by a charismatic fellow mutant and joins a long march to another continent.

feats.scene: Anntileo smashes a locked cellar gate with a shoulder charge.
Anntileo withstands a beating from guards and only grunts.

reply.summary: Taueorlli is a purple, yellow-eyed long-necked reptile hunter from a mirror-image world who flies, breathes flame and bears a hide like armour. Taueorlli serves a sinister master and is eventually killed by a rampaging giant.

feats.scene: Taueorlli exhales a cone of fire that burns a stand of forest to ash.
Taueorlli shrugs off a cannonade of boulders that would level a house.

reply.summary: Entrnu is a blonde housemaid who loves her employer like a sister and wishes her happiness. Entrnu keeps the household running and is lost in the first two chapters of an adventure that is not hers.

feats.scene: Entrnu throws open a heavy curtain and lets sunlight into a gloomy hall.
Entrnu stays on her feet after tripping over a rug.

reply.summary: Saleoiu is a masked criminal known only by a gruesome title, recorded as one of several rogues beaten by a young hero. Saleoiu leaves hardly any trace beyond a vague reputation for menace.

feats.scene: Saleoiu clubs a guard with a heavy candlestick during a break-in.
Saleoiu is pounded into a wall by a young hero and goes quiet.

reply.summary: Rnoileva is a robed leader of a crimson-themed cult in a rainy island country who worships a demon lord. Rnoileva ends his own life as an offering, hoping to feed the creature he serves.

feats.scene: Rnoileva plunges a ritual knife into a stone altar and cracks it.
Rnoileva stands unmoving as his followers chant and the candles gutter.

reply.summary: Ariumci is a grey-haired headmaster of a school for budding villains who bends minds with a gesture. Ariumci reads thoughts, throws illusions, hurls crimson concussive blasts and strikes with fists charged to cut through steel.

feats.scene: Ariumci hurls a red blast that caves in a dormitory wall and drops the roof.
Ariumci stands in a hail of cannon fire, the shells deflected by a faint red glow.

reply.summary: Rautorlu is a red-eyed, black-haired zealot who was infected by a swarming alien egg and now preaches union with the swarm. Rautorlu kidnaps a gifted girl, infects his followers, and boasts that two worlds will fall to his flock.

feats.scene: Rautorlu throws a trapped prisoner into a pit of his writhing followers.
Rautorlu stands unharmed as a rescuer's bolt strikes the lair roof.

reply.summary: Ilernillu is a giant robot with a single glassy lens and no hair or voice to speak of. Ilernillu serves as a sparring partner for a young hero's silly staring practice, and it never blinks.

feats.scene: Ilernillu swivels its lens and bats a juggling ball across the room.
Ilernillu is rammed by a runaway cart and is not even scuffed.

reply.summary: Stivalrni is a bald-headed priest of a criminal faith who rules a vast junkyard of rotting boats and teaches lessons in blood. Stivalrni falls in a duel with his own pupil, who inherits his seat.

feats.scene: Stivalrni drives a hard palm into a challenger's chest and sends him sprawling.
Stivalrni takes a savage beating on the deck of a derelict hull.

reply.summary: Senan is a blond young man from a farming commune whose charisma draws followers and whose illness drives his visions. Senan sprouts feathered wings in times of crisis and rises into the air with them.

feats.scene: Senan sweeps his wings and knocks a startled neighbour off his feet.
Senan is thrown from a barn loft and takes flight before he lands.

reply.summary: Stcar is a brown-haired student demagogue who stirs a crowd by invoking a famous clown's menace. Stcar loses his nerve when the real thing shows up and is shut down with ease.

feats.scene: Stcar shoves a heckler off a campus podium.
Stcar is subdued in a single move and his rally ends.

reply.summary: Llesasam is a blond ganglord who bosses a squad of thugs and keeps losing to a pint-sized hero. Llesasam meets a quick defeat after a single scuffle in a warehouse.

feats.scene: Llesasam smacks a lackey across the face for missing a payment.
Llesasam is bounced off crates by a tiny foe and stays down.

reply.summary: Ceoniium is a black-haired youngest son of an alien dynasty who inherits only half the family's power. Ceoniium grows into a bitter party boy, is tricked by a scientist into becoming a living bomb, and wakes up with no memory of the blast.

feats.scene: Ceoniium detonates the weapon hidden in his body and levels a hall.
Ceoniium and his twin stand in the fireball of a nuclear test as children and are only bruised.

reply.summary: Ceoamota is a blond physicist divorced from his wife who is possessed by a demon of vengeance through a black gem. Ceoamota studies solar energy, the one thing the demon fears, and learns to command its powers if he keeps his temper.

feats.scene: Ceoamota lets the gem's dark light spill across a laboratory and melts the walls.
Ceoamota is hauled from his lab by gangsters and takes their gunfire in the demon's shell.

reply.summary: Sataurer is a brown-haired boy raised by two famous champions who escapes his dying world in a makeshift ship powered by a green ring and battery. Sataurer survives as the last of his world and drifts alone to a new planet.

feats.scene: Sataurer crashes through a hangar door at launch and rips the frame from its mount.
Sataurer rides out the shock wave of his world's final collapse inside the hull.

reply.summary: Tercist is a brown-furred pet hyena with strong claws, sharp fangs and a nose that never misses a trail. Tercist follows a wild mistress and somehow slips out of every near-death scrape.

feats.scene: Tercist bites through a heavy leather lead and bolts after a scent.
Tercist is kicked across a room and trots back, wagging.

reply.summary: Raniril is a six-foot-nine working-class engineer with a dark outfit who patrols a poor neighbourhood after dark. Raniril builds his own weapons and vehicles, outthinks gangsters, and keeps pushing forward in a city built to crush its poor.

feats.scene: Raniril drives a pipe through a mobster's armoured car door.
Raniril is flattened by a tractor-trailer bumper and rises to his feet.

reply.summary: Serrerela is a black-haired, blue-eyed industrialist in an age of steam who dons a grey costume to haunt the city's criminals. Serrerela trains for ten years after his parents die and then uncovers a plot to arm a foreign power.

feats.scene: Serrerela flings a steam-pressure bomb that blows down a warehouse door.
Serrerela is hurled through a factory window and rolls up ready for another round.

reply.summary: Tiaines is a gadget-loaded night vigilante whose intimidating reputation spreads by word of mouth. Tiaines is said to have struggled to balance a double life and was apparently wiped away when a wave of antimatter swept his universe.

feats.scene: Tiaines fires a grapple line that yanks a runaway thug off his feet.
Tiaines lands hard on a fire escape after a rooftop chase.

reply.summary: Colar is a caped protector of a dark city in an alternate world, known to the public only through a newspaper report. Colar once captured a grinning clown criminal and is otherwise a rumour.

feats.scene: Colar tackles a clown-faced crook and pins him against a billboard.
Colar is thrown through a shop display and brushes off the glass.

reply.summary: Ereresti is a blue-eyed costumed hero who joins an alliance against a wall of antimatter sweeping across the cosmos. Ereresti is erased with the rest, and a rebirth of reality later restores him elsewhere.

feats.scene: Ereresti hurls a hooked blade into a collapsing girder to hold it for others.
Ereresti stands his ground in a rain of debris before the wave takes him.

reply.summary: Irntiu is a brown-haired psychologist who buys a notorious asylum to heal its inmates with kindness and dons a costume to bring in the worst of them. Irntiu is driven mad by laughing gas and ends up a patient in his own wards.

feats.scene: Irntiu knocks a raving inmate flat with a single shoulder block.
Irntiu sits unflinching as a cell door slams on his hand.

reply.summary: Telnaste is a gruff, brilliant gadget-user who builds talking cars and bikes to help him fight crime. Telnaste knows demolitions, driving and stealth, and keeps the mood of his animated cave firmly serious.

feats.scene: Telnaste sets a shaped charge that drops a derelict bridge span into the river.
Telnaste rides a rough landing from a grappling swing without complaint.

reply.summary: Iasor is a black-haired retired hero and corporate chief whose daughter inherited a feline agility from her mother. Iasor lost his love to a shape-shifting killer, hung up the cowl, and stayed distant from his child for years.

feats.scene: Iasor lands a clean kick that sends a burglar over a desk.
Iasor works through the pain of a bad fall and still finishes the job.

reply.summary: Nutaril is a heavyset, blue-eyed night fighter with no inborn powers but great stubbornness. Nutaril relies on acrobatics, martial training, stealth and tracking, wielding a rope, a belt of tools and a fast car.

feats.scene: Nutaril swings from a rope and drives both boots into a gunman's chest.
Nutaril takes a hard blow from a thug's pipe and keeps stalking.
